description: One search across Polymarket, Kalshi and Limitless: matching open markets with each venue's Yes/No price, volume, liquidity, close date and link. Where the same question trades on two venues (same numbers, close date and title words), both prices and the gap. Up to 3 Polymarket markets carry the smart-money tilt: which side the top 100 traders by monthly P&L hold among the biggest holders. Without q, the busiest markets. Live public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
